script: A finished project teaches you more than many unfinished lessons. Use a simple rhythm. Each day, do one lesson and one practice task. Each week, finish one piece of work and share it with one person for feedback. Ask two short questions: what works, and what should I change? Then make the change. This cycle of learn, practise, share and improve is the engine of the whole route. If you miss a day, do not panic. Return the next day and continue. Before you move on, check four things. Have you chosen one main skill and written it down? Do you have a learning routine and a weekly plan in your calendar? Have you completed the foundations lessons? And have you made at least one practice piece and shown it to someone for feedback? If you can tick all four, you are ready for chapter five.
